parsed.rationale: All four types — `AccentHueKey`, `AccentSaturationKey`, `AccentBrightnessKey`, and `LCDActiveBrightnessKey` — are structurally identical `type-alias-object` declarations in `Shared/PlayerHeaderView/Sources/PlayerHeaderView/AccentColorEnvironment.swift` within the `PlayerHeaderView` package, each with zero fields beyond the single shared structural slot (`shared_field_count: 1`). This is the classic SwiftUI `EnvironmentKey` boilerplate pattern where each key type is a trivial struct differing only in its name and default value. A Swift attached macro `@EnvironmentKey` could synthesize the conformance body, reducing four near-identical declarations to four one-line macro invocations and preventing future drift as new keys are added.
